ambientAblation.meaning: Current Trilight environment-light source ablation. Direct-light, reflection-intensity, probe and cubemap settings stay fixed. Any SH-dependent glossy fallback may also change; this does not isolate pure diffuse energy or grant art approval.
derivedObservations: 27 effective ambientSH coefficients must equal zero
ambientAblation.restoration: All recorded ambient controls and effective SH must equal initial values; scene/material/state/disk proof and per-case exact baseline PNG restoration remain required.
ambientAblation.effectProof: Different encoded PNG and at least one different decoded RGB code value; no artistic or minimum-magnitude acceptance threshold.
ambientAblation.protocolCompatibility: Schema 3 adds six real ambient control fields. Schema 2 is rejected by this new verifier/safety screen; old artifacts require their frozen verifier and never gain acceptance by upgrade.
ambientAblation.nativeStatus: CANDIDATE_NOT_YET_RUN_IN_UNITY: immediate effective-SH recomputation and decoded pixel effect must both be established by a fresh native run.
ambientAblation.observationSafety: Six added fields have exact keys/types: ambientMode is a fixed Unity enum; intensity is finite 0..8; RGB is finite 0..8; alpha is finite 0..1. Semantic validation additionally requires Trilight, the fixed day baseline, exact RGB zero only in this case, and exact unchanged intensity/alpha.
